Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the final step by misinterpreting the data extracted from the Wikipedia page. While the Wikipedia page clearly states "Naha, Okinawa, Japan" (identifying Naha as the city and Okinawa as the prefecture), the Planner incorrectly concluded that "Naha" and "Okinawa" are the same entity (an eponymous municipality) and arbitrarily changed the answer to "Okinawa City, Okinawa, Japan." This contradicts the explicit text of the source ("Naha, Okinawa") and the actual geography (Naha is the capital city of Okinawa Prefecture, not "Okinawa City"). The Planner failed to accurately extract the specific city name provided in the source.
